card.name: Linking words in abuse and depression lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'and' or a comma that come right after a harm-related noun in a list, like 'alcohol and illicit drugs' or 'depression, any unusual changes'. Also 'Against' in the phrase 'Strikes Against Strokes'.

modes.label: And after alcohol
modes.description: The word 'and' after 'alcohol' or 'abuse' in opioid warning lists, before drugs or misuse.
modes.example: including alcohol<< and>> illicit drugs [see PRECAUTIONS

modes.label: Comma after depression
modes.description: A comma after 'depression' in a list of mood and behavior warning signs.
modes.example: signs and symptoms of depression<<,>> any unusual changes in mood or behavior,

modes.description: The word 'Against' inside a campaign-style title.
